5. The Apex Court in the case of Chandra @ Chanda @ Chandraram & Anr. Vs. Mukesh Kumar Yadav reported in (2022) 1 SCC 198 : 2021 SCC OnLine SC 3093 has held that where the income of the deceased is taken on guess work, circular issued under the Minimum Wages Act should be resorted to.

sentences.text: 6. In the light of the aforesaid, on the date of accident i.e. on 04.03.2023 income of the deceased is to be taken as Rs.9,325/- considering him as 'Unskilled Labour', whereas the learned Claims Tribunal has taken the income as Rs.6,500/- only.

Accordingly, the just and proper compensation comes as under:-
Rs.9,325/- + Rs.2,331/-(25% FP) =Rs.11,656/- x 12 Loss of =Rs.1,39,872 less (1/4 personal expenses) x 14

Dependency (multiplier) =Rs.14,68,656/- Consortium Rs.44,000/- x Rs.2,20,000/-
Loss of Estate Rs.16,500/- Funeral Rs.16,500/-
 Expenses

Total: Rs.17,21,656/-
 MACT  Rs.12,76,624/-
 Award:

 Amount NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2026:MPHC-IND:8945 3 MA-8639-2024 7.
Thus, the just and proper amount of compensation in the instant case is Rs.17,21,656/- as against the award of the Tribunal of Rs.12,76,624/-.
Accordingly, the appellants are entitled to an enhanced amount of Rs.4,45,032/- over and above the amount which has been awarded by the Tribunal.

8. The appeal is valued as Rs.3,00,000/- and for the rest of the amount the claimants will pay the requisite Court fees within a period of 30 days from today and only thereafter enhanced amount will be disbursed.
It is made clear, in case the court fees is not paid within the stipulated period, the appellants will not be entitled for claiming interest on the enhanced amount beyond 30 days' period.
9. Accordingly, the appeal is partly allowed to the extent indicated herein above.
The enhanced amount shall carry interest at the same rate as has been awarded by the Claims Tribunal.
The other terms and conditions of the impugned award shall remain intact.

Accordingly, the just and proper compensation comes as under:-
Rs.9,325/- + Rs.2,331/-(25% FP) =Rs.11,656/- x 12 Loss of =Rs.1,39,872 less (1/4 personal expenses) x 14
Dependency (multiplier) =Rs.14,68,656/- Consortium Rs.44,000/- x Rs.2,20,000/-
Loss of Estate Rs.16,500/- Funeral Rs.16,500/-
 Expenses
Thus, the just and proper amount of compensation in the instant case is Rs.17,21,656/- as against the award of the Tribunal of Rs.12,76,624/-.
Accordingly, the appellants are entitled to an enhanced amount of Rs.4,45,032/- over and above the amount which has been awarded by the Tribunal.
8. The appeal is valued as Rs.3,00,000/- and for the rest of the amount the claimants will pay the requisite Court fees within a period of 30 days from today and only thereafter enhanced amount will be disbursed.
It is made clear, in case the court fees is not paid within the stipulated period, the appellants will not be entitled for claiming interest on the enhanced amount beyond 30 days' period.
9. Accordingly, the appeal is partly allowed to the extent indicated herein above.
The enhanced amount shall carry interest at the same rate as has been awarded by the Claims Tribunal.
The other terms and conditions of the impugned award shall remain intact.
